query: Zurückweisung von Asylsuchenden an den deutschen Grenzen
statement_de: Asylsuchende sollten an den deutschen Grenzen abgewiesen werden, wenn sie aus einem sicheren Drittland kommen.
statement_en: Asylum seekers should be rejected at the German borders if they come from a safe third country.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their stance on rejecting asylum seekers from safe countries.

statement_de: Der Familiennachzug für subsidiär Schutzberechtigte sollte ausgesetzt werden.
statement_en: Family reunification for those entitled to subsidiary protection should be suspended.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on family reunification policies for those with subsidiary protection.

statement_de: Die Einbürgerung sollte nach fünf Jahren Aufenthalt in Deutschland möglich sein.
statement_en: Naturalization should be possible after five years of residence in Germany.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on the duration of residence required for naturalization.

statement_de: Die Schuldenbremse im Grundgesetz sollte reformiert werden, um mehr öffentliche Investitionen zu ermöglichen.
statement_en: The debt brake in the Basic Law should be reformed to allow for more public investments.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on reforming the debt brake for public investment.

statement_de: Deutschland sollte eine Vermögensteuer für sehr hohe Vermögen einführen.
statement_en: Germany should introduce a wealth tax for very high assets.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their support or opposition to a wealth tax.

statement_de: Der Solidaritätszuschlag sollte abgeschafft werden.
statement_en: The solidarity surcharge should be abolished.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on the necessity of the solidarity surcharge.

statement_de: Die Unternehmenssteuern sollten auf maximal 25 Prozent gesenkt werden.
statement_en: Corporate taxes should be reduced to a maximum of 25 percent.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on corporate tax rates.

statement_de: Der gesetzliche Mindestlohn sollte auf mindestens 15 Euro pro Stunde angehoben werden.
statement_en: The statutory minimum wage should be raised to at least 15 euros per hour.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on the minimum wage increase.

statement_de: Das Bürgergeld sollte durch eine Grundsicherung mit strengeren Sanktionen ersetzt werden.
statement_en: The citizen's allowance (Bürgergeld) should be replaced by basic support with stricter sanctions.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on the adequacy of the citizen's allowance in relation to living costs.

statement_de: Das Renteneintrittsalter sollte auf 65 Jahre gesenkt werden.
statement_en: The retirement age should be lowered to 65 years.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their positions on the retirement age and its implications.

statement_de: Die private Krankenversicherung sollte in die Bürgerversicherung integriert werden.
statement_en: Private health insurance should be integrated into citizen insurance.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their support for integrating private health insurance into a solidarity-based system.

statement_de: Die Mietpreisbremse sollte dauerhaft gelten.
statement_en: The rent brake (Mietpreisbremse) should apply permanently.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on the effectiveness and necessity of rent control measures.

statement_de: Deutschland sollte keine Waffenlieferungen an die Ukraine mehr leisten.
statement_en: Germany should stop delivering weapons to Ukraine.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on military support for Ukraine.

statement_de: Deutschland sollte wieder Gas aus Russland beziehen.
statement_en: Germany should buy gas from Russia again.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on sanctions against Russia and energy imports.

statement_de: Deutschland sollte die Wehrpflicht wieder einführen.
statement_en: Germany should reintroduce compulsory military service.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on military service and defense policy.

statement_de: Deutschland sollte deutlich mehr als zwei Prozent seiner Wirtschaftsleistung für Verteidigung ausgeben.
statement_en: Germany should spend well over two percent of its GDP on defence.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their support for NATO spending commitments.

query: Europäische Union vertiefen, Mehrheitsentscheidungen statt Einstimmigkeit
statement_de: Die EU sollte mehrheitliche Entscheidungen anstelle von Einstimmigkeit einführen.
statement_en: The EU should introduce majority decisions instead of unanimity.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on decision-making processes within the EU.

query: Kernkraft, Atomkraftwerke wieder in Betrieb nehmen
statement_de: Deutschland sollte die Nutzung von Atomkraftwerken wieder erlauben.
statement_en: Germany should allow the use of nuclear power plants again.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on nuclear energy's role in Germany's energy policy.

statement_de: Das Gebäudeenergiegesetz (Heizungsgesetz) sollte abgeschafft werden.
statement_en: The Buildings Energy Act (heating law) should be repealed.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on state intervention in energy solutions.

statement_de: Deutschland sollte den Verkauf von Neuwagen mit Verbrennungsmotoren ab 2035 verbieten.
statement_en: Germany should ban the sale of new cars with combustion engines from 2035.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their support or opposition to banning combustion engine vehicles.

statement_de: Deutschland sollte sich mehr Zeit lassen, klimaneutral zu werden, als bis 2045.
statement_en: Germany should take longer than 2045 to become climate neutral.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing timelines and approaches to achieving climate neutrality.

statement_de: Die Einnahmen aus dem CO2-Preis sollten als Klimageld pro Kopf an alle Bürger ausgezahlt werden.
statement_en: Revenue from the CO2 price should be paid back to all citizens as an equal per-capita climate dividend.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on using CO2 pricing for social relief versus market-based approaches.

statement_de: Auf Autobahnen sollte ein Tempolimit von 130 km/h eingeführt werden.
statement_en: A speed limit of 130 km/h should be introduced on motorways.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on introducing a speed limit on motorways.

statement_de: Das Deutschlandticket sollte dauerhaft vom Bund mitfinanziert werden.
statement_en: The federal government should permanently co-fund the Deutschlandticket.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on the pricing and permanence of the Deutschlandticket.

statement_de: Die Legalisierung von Cannabis sollte rückgängig gemacht werden.
statement_en: The legalisation of cannabis should be reversed.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their differing views on cannabis legalization.

statement_de: Der Schwangerschaftsabbruch sollte aus dem Strafrecht entfernt werden.
statement_en: Abortion should be removed from criminal law.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on the legal status of abortion.

statement_de: Das Selbstbestimmungsgesetz zur Änderung des Geschlechtseintrags sollte abgeschafft werden.
statement_en: The Self-Determination Act for changing one's legal gender should be repealed.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on the requirements for changing gender entries.

statement_de: Das Wahlalter für Bundestagswahlen sollte auf 16 Jahre gesenkt werden.
statement_en: The voting age for federal elections should be lowered to 16 years.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their positions on youth participation in elections.

statement_de: Deutschland sollte bundesweite Volksentscheide einführen.
statement_en: Germany should introduce nationwide referendums.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on direct democracy and referendums.

statement_de: Internetanbieter sollten verpflichtet werden, IP-Adressen ohne konkreten Verdacht für einige Wochen zu speichern.
statement_en: Internet providers should be required to store IP addresses for a few weeks without specific suspicion.
rationale: This statement divides the parties based on their views on data retention practices and privacy rights.
